The SPLC was just indicted for one kind of fraud. Twitter was investigating another. When you get paid big bucks to find hate, you won't NOT find it

racket.news/p/listen-to-this…

Her record is full of lies/distortions, to the very end of her life. I'm sure she had difficult times, but journalistically, you cannot rely on the word of a person who has this many issues. Would any prosecutor call a cop who's lied on the stand as a witness? No.

Let’s review: Giuffre files a suit alleging Epstein trafficked her to Dershowitz seven times, including graphic descriptions. Dershowitz denies it and calls her a “total liar” and “extortionist,” after which she sues him again, for defamation. He countersues and produces travel records showing her claims can’t be true. They have a global settlement in which everyone agrees to drop their cases and say it was all just a big “mistake.” So yes, Dershowitz said the “extortionist” accusation made afte

I’m saying someone who lies for years in a lawsuit is the definition of unreliable. Are you unwell?


Truth Teller (@TruthTelle64058)

Why are you bringing "the court" back into this, Matt?

We don't live in a courthouse, I repeat.



— https://nitter.net/TruthTelle64058/status/2048515555309793463#m

So someone who lied to the court for years can still be a “reliable narrator”? How does one become unreliable in that case?


Truth Teller (@TruthTelle64058)

That's not how life works, Matt.

We don't live in a courthouse.



— https://nitter.net/TruthTelle64058/status/2048514619556467173#m

Once a person admits to having leveled false allegations in a lawsuit, it’s game over - you can’t rely on their accounts after that.


Truth Teller (@TruthTelle64058)

YOU SAYING "She’s a completely unreliable witness" is a problem.



— https://nitter.net/TruthTelle64058/status/2048511098580845025#m

Giuffre spent years claiming graphic sexual abuse by Alan Dershowitz before admitting to a “mistake.” She tried to sell a “fictionalized” memoir full of accusations as fact for years and claimed she sustained these injuries in a bus accident with “no visible damage.”




Truth Teller (@TruthTelle64058)

YOU SAYING "She’s a completely unreliable witness" is a problem.



— https://nitter.net/TruthTelle64058/status/2048511098580845025#m

Which victims are we talking about? Which files add up to Trump being a pedophile?


Blue Ridge Farmers Co-op Blue Ridge Farmers Co-op (@ridge_op91625)

Wow, so the victims are all fake? The FBI reports released are not substantial?…..



— https://nitter.net/ridge_op91625/status/2048510373360234616#m

Of course he has, but it seems to me that adds to the incentive to not lie about him. Why bother? The truth isn’t sufficient?


Patrick Enright (@Patrick_134)

You have to love this comment when you factor in trump has trafficked in baseless accusations for decades.



— https://nitter.net/Patrick_134/status/2048509617097805980#m

I hear you. I feel the same. I am so tired of having to machete out the weasel words in every politics story


Jonathan Williams (@therealjonobo)

Your take on russiagate was when I really started paying attention to you. There are so many of us who simply want a smart, dispassionate assessment of current events without having to filter it through which side the presenter is on.



— https://nitter.net/therealjonobo/status/2048508937134014796#m

Exactly. I’m no fan of Trump but these incantations are ridiculous — who benefits from just spreading baseless accusations?


Jonathan Keller🇺🇸 (@HawkeyeKeller55)

I've been asking for years...where is the alleged evidence that Trump is a pedo?  I'm not a Trump supporter but this pedo talk seems like nonsense. 

Show me evidence of any pedo and I'll help with the wood chipper.



— https://nitter.net/HawkeyeKeller55/status/2048507838511640993#m
